verdict.rationale: An inference API could plausibly accept remote MCP servers as tools, as some providers do, so this axis applies to DeepInfra. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP, tool calling, or any way to attach external tool servers. OpenAI SDK compatibility and the chat completions API are adjacent features and do not show MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
